notes: A K-pop stage that players perform on with a crowd facing it is Entertainment's Performance Venue, and the genre notes are explicit that a stage with an audience is its own layout because orientation is the whole design — so venue-stage rather than forcing the stage into landmark-focal. Trying on the members' dresses is genuine dress-up, so Roleplay & Avatar Sim is named as secondary, but Entertainment keeps the shape since the answer says players perform for an audience. The backstage dressing room is stated outright and players go into it, so backstage-support and its P3 are earned rather than assumed; P3 is not shipping yet, which is worth flagging upstream, but the feature is the request and cannot be dropped. I dropped the preset's spectator-bleachers because the author asked for a small audience area and raked seating exists to keep sightlines from the rear of a large room, which keeps this off tiered elevation.
